HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   B. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   C. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.

10. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.

14. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

16. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Equity and non- discrimination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Linguistic groups in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Establishment of colonial rule and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
